comment: Translations were read from the expanded Lean signatures alone; paper wording was not used to omit binders, premises, coercions, or conclusion shape.

author_approved_corrected_model_theorem1.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] {M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))} {sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ} (model : ClarifiedSourceModel M sampleRate), \exists rate, correctedTheorem1Rate = ↑rate \land HasExponentialRate (fun k  =>  1 - sourceStateWk (stateLaw k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k)) rate

author_confirmed_clarified_iid_state_law.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} {M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))} {sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ} (model : ClarifiedSourceModel M sampleRate) (k : ℕ), stateLaw k = iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k

author_confirmed_clarified_model_theorem.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] {M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))} {sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ} (model : ClarifiedSourceModel M sampleRate), HasExtendedExponentialRate (fun k  =>  1 - sourceStateWk (stateLaw k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k)) correctedTheorem1Rate

author_confirmed_clarified_uniform_type_.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} {M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))} {sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ} (model : ClarifiedSourceModel M sampleRate), type_prior = clarifiedUniformTypePrior n ⋯

source_appendix_pk_ld_complement_rate_ii.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ), FiniteOrdinalSourceModel M sampleRate \to (\forall (theta : Fin n), 0 < sampleRate theta) \to 1 \le m \to \forall (p : finiteChainOrderedPair n), \exists rate, pairwiseSellerThresholdRateTop M sampleRate (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p) = ↑rate \land ExponentialRateCertificate (fun k  =>  1 - sourceStatePairwisePk (iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k) p) rate

source_appendix_problessthan_score_gap_r.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ), FiniteOrdinalSourceModel M sampleRate \to (\forall (theta : Fin n), 0 < sampleRate theta) \to 1 \le m \to \forall (p : finiteChainOrderedPair n), \exists rate, pairwiseSellerThresholdRateTop M sampleRate (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p) = ↑rate \land ExponentialRateCertificate (fun k  =>  sourceStateScoreGapLeftTailProb (iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k) p) rate

source_definition_aggregate_score_formul.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {Rating : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Rating] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rating] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) Rating) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ) (k : ℕ) (sample : finiteChainJointFloorRatingSample Rating sampleRate k) (theta : Fin n), finiteChainJointFloorAverageScore M sampleRate k sample theta = (↑(floorSampleCount sampleRate theta k))⁻¹ * \sum i, score (sample theta i)

source_definition_extended_rate_function.tex_statement: \forall {Seller : Type u_1} {Rating : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Rating] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rating] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel Seller Rating) (theta : Seller) (a : ℝ), sourcePaperRateFunctionTop M theta a = sSup (range fun z  =>  ↑z * ↑a - ↑(sourcePaperLogMGF M theta z))

source_definition_floor_sample_count_for.tex_statement: \forall {Seller : Type u_1} (sampleRate : Seller \to ℝ) (theta : Seller) (k : ℕ), floorSampleCount sampleRate theta k = ⌊↑k * sampleRate theta⌋₊

source_definition_log_mgf_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Seller : Type u_1} {Rating : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Rating] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rating] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel Seller Rating) (theta : Seller) (z : ℝ), sourcePaperLogMGF M theta z = log (\sum y, ((typeLaw theta) y).toReal * exp (z * score y))

source_definition_pairwise_objective_for.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {Omega : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Omega] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Omega] (mu : PMF Omega) (score : Omega \to Fin n \to ℝ) (p : finiteChainOrderedPair n), sourceStatePairwisePk mu score p = (pmfProb mu fun omega  =>  score omega (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) > score omega (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p)) - pmfProb mu fun omega  =>  score omega (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) < score omega (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p)

source_definition_rate_function_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Seller : Type u_1} {Rating : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Rating] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rating] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel Seller Rating) (theta : Seller) (a : ℝ), sourcePaperRateFunction M theta a = sSup (range fun z  =>  z * a - sourcePaperLogMGF M theta z)

source_definition_uniform_ranking_normal.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {Omega : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Omega] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Omega] (mu : PMF Omega) (score : Omega \to Fin n \to ℝ), 2 \le n \to sourceStateWk mu score = sourceStateUniformWk mu score

source_definition_uniform_ranking_object.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {Omega : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Omega] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Omega] (mu : PMF Omega) (score : Omega \to Fin n \to ℝ), sourceStateWk mu score = 2 / (↑n * (↑n - 1)) * \sum p, sourceStatePairwisePk mu score p

source_fidelity_diagnostic_unrestricted_.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ), FiniteOrdinalSourceModel M sampleRate \to (\forall (theta : Fin n), 0 < sampleRate theta) \to 1 \le m \to \forall (p : finiteChainOrderedPair n), pairwiseSellerThresholdRate M sampleRate (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p) = 0 \land 0 < pairwiseSellerThresholdRateTop M sampleRate (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p)

source_iid_completion_pairwise_objective.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {Rating : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Rating] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rating] [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) Rating) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ) (p : finiteChainOrderedPair n) (k : ℕ), sourceStatePairwisePk (iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k) p = twoSampleFloorPkObjectiveProb M sampleRate (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p) k

source_iid_completion_uniform_ranking_ob.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {Rating : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Rating] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rating] [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) Rating) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ) (k : ℕ), 2 \le n \to sourceStateWk (iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k) = finiteUniformFloorPkObjective M sampleRate finiteChainOrderedPairHi finiteChainOrderedPairLo k

source_iid_completion_weak_inversion_bri.tex_statement: \forall {n : ℕ} {Rating : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Rating] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Rating] [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) Rating) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ) (p : finiteChainOrderedPair n) (k : ℕ), sourceStateScoreGapLeftTailProb (iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k) p = twoSampleFloorScoreGapLeftTailProb M sampleRate (finiteChainOrderedPairHi p) (finiteChainOrderedPairLo p) k

source_pairwise_objective_tendsto_one_ii.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ), FiniteOrdinalSourceModel M sampleRate \to (\forall (theta : Fin n), 0 < sampleRate theta) \to 1 \le m \to \forall (p : finiteChainOrderedPair n), Tendsto (fun k  =>  sourceStatePairwisePk (iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k) p) atTop (nhds 1)

source_theorem1_informative_rating_syste.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] [inst : Nonempty (finiteChainAdjacentIndex n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ), FiniteOrdinalSourceModel M sampleRate \to (\forall (theta : Fin n), 0 < sampleRate theta) \to 1 \le m \to HasExtendedExponentialRate (fun k  =>  1 - finiteUniformFloorPkObjective M sampleRate finiteChainOrderedPairHi finiteChainOrderedPairLo k) (minFiniteChainAdjacentThresholdRateTop M sampleRate)

source_uniform_ranking_objective_tendsto.tex_statement: \forall {n m : ℕ} [DecidableEq (finiteChainOrderedPair n)] [Nonempty (finiteChainAdjacentIndex n)] (M : FiniteRatingLDPModel (Fin n) (Fin (m + 1))) (sampleRate : Fin n \to ℝ), FiniteOrdinalSourceModel M sampleRate \to (\forall (theta : Fin n), 0 < sampleRate theta) \to 1 \le m \to Tendsto (fun k  =>  sourceStateWk (iidFloorSourceStateLaw M sampleRate k) (iidFloorSourceStateScore M sampleRate k)) atTop (nhds 1)
